findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: SECOND REPEAT- The only employee working was not a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM). The employee has been working on the course and should be taking the CFPM test soon. Ensure that there is always a CFPM in the facility during all hours of operation and food preparation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: There were raw, shell eggs observed to be stored above a container of marshmallow fluff and other ready-to-eat food items in one of the fridges. CORRECTED- The eggs were moved to be on the bottom shelf and this was discussed with the owner and the PIC. The owner mentioned making a sign for the fridge to keep the eggs on the bottom. Ensure that food is protected from contamination during preparation, holding, storage, and display.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.comment: There were no available signed employee reporting agreements during the inspection. The owner and the employee both stated that they were unsure of where they were. Blank copies were provided and a follow up is scheduled for 6/18/2025 to ensure that they have been signed. Ensure that these are kept in a safe place where they are accessible for all future inspections.
findings.citation_text: 2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: There were no thermometers observed to be in any of the refrigerators in the facility. This was discussed with the owner. Ensure that there is always a temperature measuring device in all cold and hot holding units.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit.

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment:
The facility has packages of pre-scooped double scoops available for sale in a cooler. These containers need to be labeled or have an ingredient list posted next to them due to the scoops being packaged for consumers to grab and go. The label information or the list should include the common name of the food, a list of ingredients and sub ingredients in descending order of predominance by weight, the name and place of the business, and any major allergens. Ensure that there is either an ingredient list with the required information posted next to the items or there are labels with the required information on each individual package. 

3-602.11(B)(1)-(4) and (6) Food Labels. (B) Label information shall include: (1) The common name of the FOOD, or absent a common name, an adequately descriptive identity statement; (2) If made from two or more ingredients, a list of ingredients and subingredients in descending order of predominance by weight, including a declaration of artificial colors, artificial flavors and chemical preservatives, if contained in the FOOD; (3) An accurate declaration of the net quantity of contents; (4) The name and place of business of the manufacturer, packer, or distributor; and (6) Except as exempted in the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act § 403(q)(3) - (5), nutrition labeling as specified in 21 CFR 101 - Food Labeling and 9 CFR 317 Subpart B Nutrition Labeling.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The trash can in the women’s restroom is observed to not have a lid on it. Ensure that in every toilet room that is used by females there is a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.
findings.citation_text: 5-501.17 Toilet Room Receptacle, Covered. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of repair: 

1. The bare wood under the legs of the triple sink needs to be sealed.
2. REPEAT- The mop sink needs to be caulked to the wall. 
3. REPEAT- The wall in back room needs to either be caulked or coved to the floor. 
4. REPEAT- The triple sink needs to be sealed to the wall to eliminate the gap. 

Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
